name: bootstrap
description: Project scaffold generator, vendored dependency manager, and startup secret emitter for new projects

capabilities.name: bootstrap.scaffold
capabilities.description: Generate 9 mandatory scaffold files (ESLint, Prettier, Husky, CI/CD, Vite, vitest, tsconfig) from templates with atomic writes and mandatory-marker validation

capabilities.name: bootstrap.dependencies
capabilities.description: Activate, report, and install the vendored Python dependency layer (vendor/python-libs) plus Playwright-managed browsers

health_checks.description: Verify generator CLI loads and lists templates

storage.description: No persistent storage; scaffold files are written into the target project
